title: Annotatio III §.VII (2a): After full examination — Evangelicals agree on the Foundation of Faith and Salvation; disputed questions do not overturn that foundation
pass_a_gloss: (2.) That when all things had been duly examined, it candidly and heartily determined that Evangelicals agree concerning the Foundation of Faith and Salvation: that the Controverted Questions less touch that foundation, and much less take it away or overturn it;
pass_b_english: (2.) After everything was duly examined, it candidly and heartily judged that Evangelicals agree on the Foundation of Faith and Salvation:
the disputed questions touch that foundation less — and still less tear it up or overturn it;
source_text: (2.) Quòd omnibus ritè examinatis, ingenuè cordatéque statuerit, convenire Evangelicis de Fundamento Fidei & Salutis: Quaestiones Controversas fundamentum istud minus attingere, minus multò tollere aut evertere;
notes: Cassellanum mark (2) opening: Fundamento Fidei & Salutis consensus; controversa minus attingere/evertere.
